closure/css/stylesheet branches.why: Under `tolerant`, a `oneOrMore` publishes what can follow its first item, so inner lists don't read the next item as junk. Its entry therefore tests whether recovery is on: one branch test per entry and no added calls. Strict table parses only reach this entry through interpreted trivia, on a detached context where recovery is always off, so the output cannot change. A `choice` reached the same way tests whether recovery is installed, one branch test per entry.
